checks.message: Documentation product must point to the documentation content catalog, CMS Site, and root route.
checks.remediation: Set contentCatalog, site, and publicRootPath on every documentation product record.

checks.message: Navigation must be expandable, searchable, renderer-bound, and product-owned.
checks.remediation: Generate or repair cmsDocumentationNavigation with product, renderer, expandable, and search placeholder metadata.

checks.message: Sibling navigation nodes must not share order inside the same parent, locale, and channel.
checks.remediation: Change the nodeOrder or parentNode for the duplicate navigation siblings.

checks.message: Every child node must reference an existing parent node.
checks.remediation: Create the missing parent node or move the child under an existing section.

checks.message: Documentation hierarchy must not contain circular parent-child relationships.
checks.remediation: Break the loop by assigning one node to an ancestor-free parent.

checks.message: Every documentation page must belong to exactly one page-link node.
checks.remediation: Create one page-link node for the page, or remove duplicate page-link nodes pointing to the same page.

checks.message: Every page-link node must point to an existing documentation page metadata record.
checks.remediation: Assign targetDocumentationPage to an existing page metadata record.

checks.message: Every hierarchy dashboard must have owner, summary, content area, and cards.
checks.remediation: Populate dashboard ownerType, ownerCode, summary, contentArea, and cards.

checks.message: Container nodes must expose dashboard/content-area metadata.
checks.remediation: Attach a dashboard and nodeContentArea to every section container node.

checks.message: Every documentation page metadata record must reference CMS page, route, and article component records.
checks.remediation: Generate or repair targetPage, targetRoute, and articleComponent references.

checks.message: Every renderable documentation record must carry a valid access policy and access mode.
checks.remediation: Assign a generated or Axis-managed access policy to each product, navigation, node, dashboard, page, and search record.

checks.message: Public documentation policies must be anonymous-readable and Online-only.
checks.remediation: Set publiclyAvailable true, requiresAuthentication false, and lifecycleVisibility including ONLINE for public policies.

checks.message: Restricted policies must define allowed roles, groups, or permissions.
checks.remediation: Add allowedRoles, allowedGroups, or allowedPermissions to restricted documentation policies.

checks.message: Authoring records may retain drafts; public delivery still requires Online publication.
checks.remediation: Keep draft/staged/review records out of public payloads until nPublish activates them Online.

checks.message: Publication states must carry lifecycle, checksum, workflow, decision policy, and actor evidence.
checks.remediation: Repair workflow triggers, decisionPolicy and lifecycle-appropriate actor evidence; do not fabricate approvals for draft or staged authoring data.

checks.message: Every publishable documentation item must have publication-state evidence.
checks.remediation: Generate cmsDocumentationPublicationState records for product, navigation, node, dashboard, and page items.

checks.message: Editable documentation records must define workflow triggers.
checks.remediation: Add workflowRequired and workflowTriggers to Axis-managed documentation records.

checks.message: Records with editable content, navigation, dashboard, access, source, or search fields must include matching workflow triggers.
checks.remediation: Add the relevant CONTENT_CHANGE, NAVIGATION_CHANGE, DASHBOARD_CHANGE, ACCESS_POLICY_CHANGE, SOURCE_EVIDENCE_CHANGE, or SEARCH_METADATA_CHANGE trigger.

checks.message: Search metadata must be index-ready with keyword, facet, access, and lifecycle filters.
checks.remediation: Regenerate or repair title, summary, searchText, keywords, facets, accessPolicy, lifecycleState, and indexState.

checks.message: Products, navigation nodes, dashboards, and pages must have search metadata.
checks.remediation: Generate cmsDocumentationSearchMetadata records for every searchable product, node, dashboard, and page.

checks.message: Page metadata must preserve source repository, source path, checksum, and word count.
checks.remediation: Regenerate page metadata from source Markdown or repair the source evidence fields.

checks.message: Page metadata must preserve diagrams, visual assets, and declared visual requirements.
checks.remediation: Add diagrams, tables, screenshots, schema models, or equivalent visual evidence and regenerate metadata.

checks.message: Related page references must point to known documentation pages.
checks.remediation: Correct relatedPages values or add the missing target page to the catalogue.

checks.message: Page metadata must contain detailed summary, business summary, and technical summary.
checks.remediation: Add business and technical perspective content before publishing the page.

checks.message: Generated manifest hashes must be stable SHA-256 values.
checks.remediation: Regenerate the content pack manifest after generated records change.

integrity.meaning: Deterministic digest for validation-report integrity; it is not a production approval signature.
